usedFor: TimeRex holds your bookings, and Documint fills a document when “Add Content To Template” follows “New Event”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Event” in TimeRex, then “Add Content To Template” in Documint
bestTemplate.why: Each new booking fills a Documint template, so a prepared document is ready for the meeting.

watchOut: “Event Rescheduled” and “Event Cancelled” are separate triggers, so a changed booking will not update the document.
